notes: Identical memory figures to apollo4-plus.json (2048 kB Shared SRAM + 384 kB TCM + 384 kB Extended SRAM = 2.75 MB; 2 MB NVM) -- Blue Plus adds a Bluetooth radio on top of the same memory subsystem, confirmed by the same 'Memory Subsystem' section wording appearing verbatim in both datasheets. This is kept as a separate profile file rather than folded into apollo4-plus.json as an alias, since these are two distinct named products (not package/pin variants of one part number the way STM32U575/585 are) -- but the shared figures are worth noting explicitly so a future edit to one doesn't silently drift from the other. Same MRAM-not-flash caveat as apollo4-plus.json applies to total_flash_bytes. dev_kit_aliases is deliberately empty for the same reason as apollo4-plus.json: no specific Ambiq evaluation board was confirmed with certainty against this exact part in the time available for this pass.
